test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, then select the option "No error".

I felt that / I was be groomed / for success in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase containing a grammatical error in the given sentence is** "I was be groomed".**
 
• The sentence *"I was being groomed for success in the world"* is in the **passive** **voice**. This is because the subject of the sentence ("I") is receiving the action (being groomed) rather than performing the action.
 
• The** correct usage** should be *"I was being groomed".*
 
• In English, **when we talk about** an action that was ongoing in the past (a past continuous action), we use** "was/were" + present participle (-ing form of the verb).**
 
• So**, "was be groomed**" should be **"was being groomed"** to correctly indicate the ongoing action in the past.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *"I felt that** I was being groomed** for success in the world." *
